t: Placing a $(5)Shock Module$() in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() makes the force field become electrified. When a player or entity comes into contact with an electrified field, they receive a shock which causes damage. Each $(5)Shock Module$() added to the Projector increases the damage done to a player or entity by half a heart.
在$(5)力场投影仪$()中放置$(l:mffs:machines/projector)电击模块$()，可使力场通电。当玩家或生物接触带电力场时，将受到电击并承受伤害。每向投射器中添加一个$(5)电击模块$()，对玩家或生物造成的伤害即增加半颗心。
